messages:
tom: dropped a compact callout concept that sits under the header and nudges users to create a sample project. figma: https://figma.com/file/onboard-callout-2026 (plz skim)
priya: quick q — persistent across devices or session-only?
tom: cross-device persist until created/dismissed (server flag recommended).
anya: a11y notes: collapsed callout needs an accessible name and visible keyboard focus. current contrast on the CTA is 3.1:1 (fail). bump to meet AA. add aria-live="polite" for create progress.
dom: impl note: client flag is trivial. server dismiss + experiment exposure will need infra ticket. timeline: client prototype in 1 sprint; server flag + telemetry in 2.
priya: copy: keep verbs-first. options: "Create sample", "Start quickstart", "Explore samples". prefer "Create sample" for clarity.
ui-bot: a11y scan: collapsed state missing tabindex, CTA contrast 3.1:1, expanded panel missing role="dialog" for screen readers.
anya: also include a post-create snippet + copy button, e.g.:

```
redwood samples run <name>
```

ensure snippet is announced to screen readers when copied.
dom: telemetry event names proposed: `onb.callout_impression`, `onb.callout_click`, `onb.sample_create`. include experiment_id and cohort on impressions.
priya: rollout A/B idea: callout vs mini-rail. run quick experiment, measure time-to-first-call and sample creation rate.
tom: agree. smoke test plan: 3 engineers new to the product, 5-min session each.
anya: i'll prepare an a11y test checklist (keyboard only, screen reader, contrast, focus return).
dom: i'll draft the server-flag PR and add hooks for experiments.
tom: filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-1150 — adding comps and checklist. thanks all :sparkles:
